items.title: What is a Material?
items.explanation: A material is any substance used to create an object. Common materials include paper, wood, cloth, glass, metal, plastic, clay, and so on.

items.title: Materials in Daily Life
items.explanation: Objects around us are made up of various materials such as paper, wood, cloth, glass, metal, plastic, clay, and others. For example, a notebook is made of paper, while a pen might contain metal or plastic.
